content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The document already sits at our preferred position on minimum commitments:

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** expressly states "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," ties fees to Services ordered under a mutually executed Order Form, and confirms declining to place a further order is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** prohibits Vendor from imposing minimum-use or similar charges not identified in the Order Form.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** records that Customer has made no minimum-volume (or exclusivity/MFC/no-hire) commitment.
- **§ 1.6 "Order Form"** limits committed quantities to what Customer actually signs, so no take-or-pay is imported at the order level; the only "shortfall" references (§§ 22.2–22.3) relate to audit underpayments, not volume.

Auto-renewal on 180 days' notice (§ 8.2) lengthens the term but does not create a purchase commitment, so it falls to the separate renewal/notice rule rather than MINCOMMIT.
